reason: The key application of lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity is unsupported at the required dimension-free scale. Its registered allowed contract says only that the inclusions must be 'sufficiently accurate'; it does not provide a single universal e_add > 0 independent of m or |U|. Node 1.5.2 assumes that t <= e_add makes the restricted maps admissible, but that universal e_add is merely invented in the already-openly-challenged node 1.1 and is not supplied by this external or any allowed definition. Therefore the asserted bijection S^A_{P_U,P_j} -> direct_sum_{k in U} S^A_{P_k,P_j}, and hence the nonzero cross-corner conclusion at a universal e_s2, do not follow from the permitted dependencies.
